name: Personal Cable TV Jellyfin Companion
description: Optional Jellyfin Companion for Personal Cable TV. Requires a working Personal Cable TV server and your own media library; media is not included.
overview: Adds the Personal Cable TV guide and cable-style viewing experience to supported Jellyfin clients. Requires Personal Cable TV and Jellyfin Live TV to be configured first. LG/webOS channel surfing is verified; Roku Jellyfin-client support is limited.

versions.changelog: EXPERIMENTAL: Numeric channel entry for Personal Cable TV live playback, Enter/OK confirmation, 2-second auto-tune, Back cancellation. LG/webOS remote verification pending; existing channel surfing preserved.

Verified LG/webOS channel-surfing release. During Personal Cable TV live playback, Up/Down changes channels while pause, rewind, fast-forward, seek/scrub, and chapter-skip remain blocked. Known limitation: the Jellyfin Roku client does not support Companion Up/Down channel surfing and may still expose Pause. Roku users should use the dedicated P.Cable TV Companion Roku app for the full live-TV experience.
